net_income_bridge.definition: Net income = operating income + non-operating income - income tax expense (plus/minus other items reported by the company). The bridge is built only from reported SEC facts.

companies.note: Non-operating income includes gains/losses on equity investments. A quarter is flagged when its absolute non-operating income is at least 10% of pre-tax income; all values are SEC XBRL facts.
